sourceText: After B-914f, fix the observed problem where invoking global lattice from a story worktree ran the main workspace old runtime for 7 minutes 28 seconds; handle it as the next independent story while continuing unattended.
normalizedOutcome: A self-host story worktree cannot silently execute a global runtime from the main checkout: the command fails before handler dispatch with one stable reason code and a copyable worktree-local recovery command, while correct local and external-project global executions still work.
acceptanceClaim: In a hermetic main-plus-linked-worktree reproduction, stale global validate exits before any handler or command execution and prints the exact local rerun command; the same command through node bin/lattice.js succeeds and external consumers are unaffected.
